name: Bambu Lab H2S

    M1002 set_filament_type:PLA

    ;===== set chamber temperature ==========

M1028 S0

M17 D

M620.10 A0 F239.471 H0.4 T240 P{hotendTemp:.0f} S1

M400

M400
M628 S0
M629

M106 P1 S0

G29.2 S1

M1002 judge_flag extrude_cali_flag

    M400 S5

    M106 P1 S0
    M400 S2

    M400 P500
    G150.2
    G150.1

G91

G90

M400

M1002 gcode_claim_action : 14
    G150 T{hotendTemp:.0f}

M106 S255 ; turn on fan to cool the nozzle

;===== wipe left nozzle end =====

M400

M400

M1002 judge_flag g29_before_print_flag

M190 S{bedTemp:.0f}; ensure bed temp
M109 S140
M106 S0 ; turn off fan , too noisy

G91
G1 Z5 F1200
G90
G1 X275 Y300 F30000

M623

M622 J2

M623

G90

    G1 X187 Y160 F20000

    M970.3 Q1 A5 K0 O1

M1026
G29.9

M140 S{bedTemp:.0f}

    M960 S2 P0 ; turn off laser

G150.1

M983.4 S1 ; turn on deformation compensation

G29.7 S1

G90
G1 Z5 F1200
G1 Y295 F30000
G1 Y265 F18000

    G90

M400

M620.6 I0 W1 ;enable ams air printing detect

M211 Z1
G29.99

G392 S0 ; turn off nozzle clog detect
M993 A0 B0 C0 ; nozzle cam detection not allowed
M400 ; wait for buffer to clear

G91

G90
M141 S0 ; turn off chamber heating
M140 S0 ; turn off bed
M106 S0 ; turn off fan
M106 P2 S0 ; turn off remote part cooling fan

M620 S65535
T65535
G150.2
M621 S65535

M17 S
